subject: AtlasAI trial readiness checklist and kickoff owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.r@atlasai.com>, Meera Patel <meera.patel@atlasai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasAI trial readiness checklist and kickoff owners

Hi Sanjay / Meera —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a concrete proposal to get the trial moving without friction:

Summary of what we covered
- Primary use case: document ingestion + embeddings powering semantic search for customer support KB.
- Target success metric: 95% top-3 retrieval precision on the seeded test set and average query latency < 150ms at 8 RPS.
- Data constraints: PII filtered on ingest; AtlasAI will route only anonymized support logs for the trial.

Proposed trial plan (2-week technical evaluation) — milestones and owners
1) Prep (Week 0) — checklist complete by AtlasAI + Redwood
   - Security questionnaire review and network allowlist (owners: Meera / Marissa)
   - SSO and service account for Redwood access (owners: AtlasAI Identity / Marissa)
2) Ingest & baseline (Week 1)
   - Sample dataset ingest (owner: AtlasAI engineering)
   - Baseline quality run + logging enabled (owner: Ben Carter, SE)
3) Tuning & validation (Week 2)
   - Prompt set validation and result review (owners: AtlasAI PM and Ben)
   - Pass/fail review against success criteria (owner: Sanjay / Marissa)

Success criteria (for go/no-go)
- Quality: >=95% top-3 precision on seed queries (measured using the shared eval sheet).
- Latency: median latency <150ms for 1k-token window under 8 RPS with continuous batching enabled.
- Stability: no more than 1% error rate over 24h stress run.

Attachments: trial-activation-checklist.docx (operational checklist), atlasai-poc-success-metrics.xlsx (eval template), redwood-security-answers.pdf (SOC/KMS notes).

Ask: Can you confirm the following by Monday 10/4?
- Procurement point of contact for contract/PO (email)
- Preferred kickoff week (we currently have 10/11 or 10/18 available)
- Any technical blockers (SSO/KMS/network policy) that would delay the prep phase

If you want, I can also open a dedicated shared Drive folder and a HubSpot milestone for the trial so both teams have a single source of truth.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: trial-activation-checklist.docx (docx, 26 KB)]

Thanks for the clear plan and the materials. A few quick notes from our side:

We can commit to the prep items assuming SSO and KMS scoping is straightforward. Two items to flag:

On success criteria: the precision threshold looks right; we'll add a secondary metric to track recall on rare entity queries.

Procurement contact: procurement@atlasai.com (we'll CC a named reviewer once I have their availability).

Forwarding Marissa's checklist to our security reviewer for a quick pass.

—Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
